from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from uuid import uuid4

url = 'http://localhost:3100/'
class FormParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.inside = False
        self.fields = {}
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'form' and a.get('class') == 'add-form': self.inside = True
        elif tag == 'input' and self.inside and a.get('type') == 'hidden': self.fields[a['name']] = a.get('value', '')
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'form': self.inside = False

body += f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()

from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from uuid import uuid4
import json

book = json.load(open('/tmp/reading-shelf-notes-smoke.json'))[0]
url = 'http://localhost:3100/books/' + book['id']
class FormParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.details = False; self.inside = False; self.fields = {}
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'details' and a.get('class') == 'notes-edit': self.details = True
        elif tag == 'form' and self.details: self.inside = True
        elif tag == 'input' and self.inside: self.fields[a['name']] = a.get('value', '')
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'form': self.inside = False
        if tag == 'details': self.details = False
parser = FormParser(); parser.feed(urlopen(url).read().decode())
fields = parser.fields | {'notes': 'Updated note from the detail page'}
boundary = '----ReadingShelf' + uuid4().hex
body = b''.join((f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n').encode() for name, value in fields.items()) + f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
response = urlopen(Request(url, body, {'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}', 'Origin': 'http://localhost:3100'}, method='POST'))
saved = json.load(open('/tmp/reading-shelf-notes-smoke.json'))[0]
page = urlopen(url).read().decode()
print('save response:', response.status, 'file updated:', saved['notes'] == fields['notes'], 'detail updated:', fields['notes'] in page)
PY"
